conbody.p: When the trailer’s connector is plugged into your vehicle, driver assistance systems of your vehicle turns off if Tow Bar Wiring Kit is equipped or original vehicle connectors and a multifunctional trailer module is installed. In this case, you cannot get help from them. Always drive with care.

li.p: The information provided may differ according to which functions are applicable to your vehicle.
Please consult your dealer for more information on this feature.
